verdicts.reason: A actually re-arranges the layout for the taller canvas: a large headline, the CTA under the copy and the logo enlarged on the right. But the badges are mismatched: FREE is oversized and as heavy as the Save a Seat button, so it competes with the CTA, and the badge order is swapped. The body copy also leaves an orphan, 'roastery.', on its second line. B is the original banner simply spread vertically: the text is small for the canvas, there are dead bands at the top and bottom, and the badges float loosely with no tie to the copy. It is faithful but lazy.

A is the original layout stretched out: the type is undersized, the space at the top and bottom is wasted, and the headline, body and badges are spaced loosely so the group feels disconnected. B has the stronger hierarchy and fills the space better, but the body copy is jammed directly under the two-line headline with almost no leading gap. The badges sit above the headline, mismatched in size, with FREE oversized and their order swapped. The CTA floats alone on the right, away from the copy block.

In A the headline 'Free Saturday cupping' runs to within a few pixels of the right edge, which is cramped and looks almost cut off. The FREE badge is as large and heavy as the Save a Seat CTA and competes with it, the badges are inconsistently sized, and 'roastery.' is orphaned. B keeps the original structure cleanly with nothing cramped, though its text is small and there is dead space above and below.
